name: Mehmed III
role: Sultan of the Ottoman Empire from 1595 to 1603
contribution: The sultan of the Ottoman Empire from 1595 until his death in 1603.
legacy: Upon ascending to the throne, this person ordered that all of his nineteen brothers be executed.

checks.lead: Mehmed III (Ottoman Turkish: محمد ثالث, Meḥmed-i sālis; Turkish: III. Mehmed; 26 May 1566 – 22 December 1603) was the sultan of the Ottoman Empire from 1595 until his death in 1603.
